snippet.title: GODZILLA MINUS ZERO | Official Trailer 3 - NOW PLAYING
snippet.description:
GODZILLA MINUS ZERO #FilmedForIMAX
VFX, Written, and Directed by Takashi Yamazaki

Now Playing in theatres nationwide & IMAX

Follow @godzilla_toho and @GKIDSfilms for more updates!
godzillaminuszero.com

War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life.

Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant.
 
There is no third time. Everything ends here.

Shot entirely in Japan as the first-ever Japanese production to be Filmed For IMAX, GODZILLA MINUS ZERO was shot with high-definition digital cameras certified by IMAX, and optimized in sound and imagery unique to IMAX screens. The globally beloved monster returns to movie theater screens reaching greater and more terrifying heights, making GODZILLA MINUS ZERO a true cinematic event not to be missed.

snippet.title: Julia Wieniawa, Malik Montana - Chwila zapomnienia
snippet.description:
🎧 Posłuchaj utworu we wszystkich serwisach streamingowych: https://e-muzyka.link/JuliaWieniawaMalikMontanaChwilazapomnienia

Jedna z najpopularniejszych gwiazd współczesnego popu i raper, którego bezkompromisowy styl przyciąga miliony słuchaczy, postanowili dać się ponieść wspólnej muzycznej przygodzie. „Chwila zapomnienia” opowiada o elektryzującym spotkaniu i momencie, w którym rozsądek ustępuje miejsca emocjom. Julia i Malik prowadzą w nim muzyczną grę, w której każde z nich zachowuje swój charakterystyczny styl. To spotkanie dwóch różnych temperamentów, które nadaje kompozycji nieoczekiwany charakter.

snippet.title: Laxmi Mantra - 108 Times | Om Mahalaxmi Namo Namah | Lakshmi Ji Mantra | Dhanteras | Diwali Song
snippet.description:
Awaken to a morning blessed with infinite wealth, divine abundance, and pure happiness with the sacred continuous chanting of "Laxmi Mantra - 108 Times" (Om Mahalaxmi Namo Namah). Listening to or meditating upon this powerful morning prayer dispels financial distress, removes negative blockages, and fills your surroundings with peace, prosperity, and positive energy.

"Om Mahalaxmi Namo Namah, Om Vishnupriyaye Namo Namah, Om Dhanpradaye Namo Namah, Om Vishwasannane Namo Namah" is a deeply auspicious Vedic invocation dedicated to Goddess Lakshmi, the consort of Lord Vishnu and the cosmic provider of wealth, well-being, and harmony. Chanting this divine mantra for 108 cycles aligns your personal vibrations with cosmic abundance. It pays homage to Maa Lakshmi not only as the giver of gold and money (Dhana), but also as the source of health, peace of mind, family concord, and spiritual illumination.

Immerse yourself in this soulful Laxmi Song with pure faith to build an impenetrable spiritual shield around your finances, career, and household. The rhythmic sound vibrations soothe an anxious mind, dissolve emotional fatigue, and cultivate sharp focus, optimism, and heartfelt gratitude. For anyone aiming for career growth, business expansion, or general household prosperity, surrendering to the divine lotus feet of Goddess Lakshmi brings total success and protection.

The ideal time to listen to this peaceful Diwali Song and mantra meditation is early morning during Brahma Muhurta, or during evening Sandhya prayers, especially on Fridays and throughout the Diwali festival season. Let the divine resonance guide you into uninterrupted meditation and joy.

Om Mahalaxmi Namo Namah! Shubh Deepawali!

snippet.title: Karōshi (2027) Official Trailer - Teo Yoo, Isabel May, Giancarlo Esposito, Cynthia Erivo
snippet.description:
Produced by Chad Stahelski (John Wick franchise), and written and directed by Takashi Doscher, KARŌSHI is an action-thriller set in a near-future Manhattan, where corporate loyalty and cultural tradition have reshaped everyday life. When a mysterious outsider infiltrates a powerful company after a worker’s death, he exposes the violent system hidden beneath its polished surface. Starring Teo Yoo (Past Lives ), Isabel May ( Scream 7 ), Takehiro Hira (“Shōgun”), Bill Camp (“Presumed Innocent”), Show Kasamatsu (“ Tokyo Vice”) with Giancarlo Esposito (“Breaking Bad”), and Cynthia Erivo (Wicked).

Also produced by Jason Spitz, Alex Young, and Nathan Kahane.

Lionsgate presents an 87Eleven Entertainment production, a True North production.

snippet.title: P1Harmony (피원하모니) - ‘BLOW UP’ MV
snippet.description:
P1Harmony (피원하모니) - ‘BLOW UP’ MV

[Apple Music] : https://music.apple.com/us/album/blow-up/6827384345
[Melon] : https://kko.to/-jVhIAE0TC
[Spotify] : https://open.spotify.com/intl-ko/album/3O78x7QhCrZfS21Qp4njPS

미니 10집 ‘BLOW UP’은 영웅으로 복귀한 피원하모니가 마지막 임무를 수행하며, 오랜 시간 이어온 HERO로서의 여정을 완성하는 이야기를 담는다. 데뷔 초부터 끝없이 확장해 온 영웅 서사를 자신들만의 방식으로 그려 낸다. 

피원하모니가 그리는 영웅은 마지막까지도 유쾌하다. 이들은 세상을 구해야 한다는 거대한 사명 속에서도 때로는 엉뚱하고, 때로는 인간적인 모습을 보여 주며 기존의 영웅 서사와는 다른 시선으로 영웅의 이야기를 확장해왔다. 이번 앨범에서도 마지막 임무를 수행하는 피원하모니의 모습을 유쾌하게 그려내며 피원하모니만의 영웅 서사를 완성한다. 

타이틀곡 ‘BLOW UP’은 PC Music의 독창적인 사운드 미학을 감각적으로 풀어낸 하이퍼팝 장르의 곡이다. 글리치한 신시사이저와 하이퍼 드럼이 만들어내는 폭발적인 사운드는 경험한 적 없는 신선한 해방감을 선사한다. 한계를 깨고 나아가며 함께 성장해 온 짜릿한 여정을 담아낸 이 곡은 자신만의 길을 걸어온 피원하모니의 독보적인 존재감을 각인시키며, 거침없이 이어져 온 그들의 행보에 더욱 강력한 추진력을 더한다.

‘BLOW UP’의 퍼포먼스는 음악의 리듬과 분위기를 움직임으로 표현하는 데 초점을 맞췄다. 곡의 흐름에 따라 동작의 속도와 강약에 변화를 주며 음악의 에너지를 살리는 방향으로 구성했다. 특히 도입부에서는 비트와 리듬을 세밀하게 표현하는 움직임으로 곡의 그루브를 자연스럽게 녹였고, 후렴구에서는 마치 하늘 위를 달리며 질주하는 듯한 안무로 곡의 속도감을 직관적으로 표현했다. 여기에 멤버들의 개성과 표현력을 살린 움직임이 더해져 그룹 특유의 자유로운 에너지를 보여주며, 피원하모니만의 역동적인 퍼포먼스를 완성한다.

이번 앨범 역시 피원하모니 멤버들의 음악적 고민과 색깔이 고스란히 녹아들었다. 인탁과 종섭은 타이틀곡을 포함한 전곡 작사에 참여했으며, 기호 역시 ‘element’의 작사와 ‘MOMENTUM’의 작사·작곡에 이름을 올렸다. 멤버들의 적극적인 음악 참여를 통해 피원하모니만의 색깔과 이야기를 더욱 선명하게 담아냈다. 

한계를 정해두지 않는 것. 그것이 피원하모니가 새로운 이야기와 새로운 음악을 만들어가는 방식이다. 영웅으로서의 마지막 임무를 마친 피원하모니는 이제 궤도를 벗어나 더 넓은 곳으로 나아간다. ‘BLOW UP’은 오랜 영웅 서사를 완성하는 동시에 한계를 넘어 더 높이, 더 멀리 뻗어가는 피원하모니의 새로운 챕터를 더욱 기대하게 하는 앨범이다. 

“BLOW UP,” P1Harmony’s tenth mini album, embodies the story of P1Harmony completing their long-time journey as a group of heroes, returning and carrying out their final mission. It portrays their narrative as a group of heroes, in their own style, which has been expanding endlessly since their debut.

The heroes portrayed by P1Harmony are cheerful until the end. They have been showing their quirky and humane sides, while carrying out their duty of saving the world and expanding their story as heroes, which sets them apart from different hero stories. This album portrays P1Harmony carrying out their final mission cheerfully, completing P1Harmony’s story as a group of heroes. 

“BLOW UP,” the title track, is a song of hyper pop genre that unfolds the original sound aesthetics of PC music. Explosive sound created by the glitchy synthesizer and hyper drums present a new feeling of freedom which has never been experienced. This song, embodying the thrilling journey of breaking through the limits, moving forward, and growing together, imprints P1Harmony’s unmatched journey, and gives momentum to the members’ unstoppable drive forward.

The performance for “BLOW UP” focuses on expressing the rhythm and vibe of the music through movements. It emphasizes the music’s energy by changing the speed and accent of the movements according to the flow of the song. In particular, the opening naturally blends the groove of the song with movements delicately portraying the beats and the rhythm, and the chorus directly expresses the speed of the song with choreography that makes the members appear as if they are racing across the sky. Additional movements that emphasize the members’ characteristics and expressions show the group’s unique free energy, and complete P1Harmony’s dynamic performance.

This album is also a blend of P1Harmony’s deep reflections and styles of music. INTAK and JONGSEOB participated in writing the lyrics for all the tracks, including the title track. KEEHO is also credited as a lyricist for “element” and a lyricist and composer for  “MOMENTUM.” Through the members’ passionate participation, P1Harmony’s style and stories are embodied more vividly.

Not setting limits. That’s how P1Harmony creates new stories and new music. After finishing their final mission as a group of heroes, P1Harmony now leaves orbit and heads to a greater world beyond. “BLOW UP” completes P1Harmony’s long narrative as a group of heroes and signals the beginning of a new chapter as they push beyond their limits and reach higher.

========= Berserker LYRICS ==========

Far from the north, as they came down the river
Ships moving forth, they descended on York
Threat to the crown, the invasion was met from the south
March through the town, onto the bridge

1, 2, 3, 4, all around him they’re falling
5, 6, 7, 8, 40 facing the axe

Fighting, halls of Valhalla waiting, never surrender
Slay them, berserker rage and mayhem, over the river 
He’s fighting, halls of Valhalla waiting, never surrender
Slay them, facing the charge alone

Blood they will bring, form a shield wall to face them
Death of a king, make a stand for revenge
Heeding the call, as the fallen in battle remain
Enter the hall, to the home of the slain

On that day in September 
As the end of an era draws near
Will the future remember
How it ended, a Berserker pierced by a spear

========= Historic Fact ==========

Berserkers were fearsome Norse warriors famed for their ferocity in battle. Old Norse accounts link them to Odin and describe them entering a frenzied state known as berserksgangr, fighting with extraordinary fury. Legend has it that during the Battle of Stamford Bridge in 1066, a lone Viking warrior held the bridge against the English army and killed numerous soldiers before being struck from below by a spear. His death allowed the English to advance and ultimately defeat Harald Hardrada’s army, in a battle often seen as marking the end of the Viking Age in England.

〈報告書〉悪魔祓い研究計画と防衛的活用について

【概要と背景】
　2014年現在、未確認現象による被害は加速度的に増加し、既存の防衛機能では手に負えない事態となっている。これを受け当局は、未確認現象の解明と防衛的な活用を進めることを政府に提案、承認され現在に至る。
　手始めに、管理が容易かつ防衛機能として優秀な「悪魔祓い」を国内に輸入し、現象の解明と防衛的活用を目指した研究を行う。

【研究の手法】
❶悪魔祓いが行われている欧米各国にて、発生条件を確認。
❷国内の児童養護施設を巡回し、最も従順な個体を引き取り、実験の対象とする。
❸さまざまな条件のもとで実験を繰り返し、効果の大小を比較する。

【研究員の報酬について】
　悪魔祓い研究に従事した者には、音博よりクラシック音楽を聴く権利が与えられる。知ってのとおりクラシック音楽は、メロディーを口ずさんだ際の「時間逆行」能力が確認されているため、1950年に音博に収容した異変物でもある。
　一般流通の禁止された音楽を聴ける背徳感は、研究員の報酬としてふさわしいと言えるだろう。

snippet.title: कुबेर अष्टलक्ष्मी धन प्राप्ति मंत्र | Kuber Mantra | KUBERA Ashta Lakshmi
snippet.description:
कुबेर अष्टलक्ष्मी धनप्राप्ति मंत्र | Kuber Mantra | KUBERA Ashta Lakshmi MANTRA 
Presents 
DRC Bhakti Music 
Singer DevRaj Chouhan 
Mantra Traditional 
Music DRC Bhakti Music

कुबेर अष्टलक्ष्मी धन प्राप्ति मंत्र का नियमित जाप करें और अपने जीवन में सुख, समृद्धि और धन के आगमन का अनुभव करें।

इस वीडियो में प्रस्तुत कुबेर अष्टलक्ष्मी धन प्राप्ति मंत्र के माध्यम से आप भगवान कुबेर और माता लक्ष्मी का आशीर्वाद प्राप्त कर सकते हैं। यह मंत्र विशेष रूप से घर में सकारात्मक ऊर्जा और आर्थिक स्थिरता लाने के लिए अत्यंत प्रभावशाली माना गया है।

यदि आप आर्थिक बाधाओं को दूर करना चाहते हैं, तो इस पवित्र मंत्र का श्रवण करें। धन प्राप्ति के लिए इस मंत्र का नियमित अभ्यास करने से व्यापार में वृद्धि और जीवन में सुख-शांति का मार्ग प्रशस्त होता है। यह शक्तिशाली मंत्र धन मंत्र के रूप में जाना जाता है जो भक्तों की मनोकामनाओं को पूर्ण करने में सहायक है।

lakshmi vishnu kuber mantra

कुबेर मंत्र और लक्ष्मी मंत्र की भक्ति से जुड़ने के लिए हमारे चैनल को सब्सक्राइब करें। आप अपनी आर्थिक स्थिति में सुधार के लिए किस मंत्र का जाप करते हैं, हमें कमेंट में जरूर बताएं।

Presented by DRC Bhakti Music
Copyright 2026 DRC BHAKTI MUSIC
All rights reserved.

#kubermantra #Laxmimantra #diwali

snippet.title: "Alpine Autumn Lake" Beautiful Relaxing Music, Peaceful Soothing Instrumental Music by Tim Janis
snippet.description:
"Alpine Autumn Lake" Beautiful Relaxing Music, Peaceful Soothing Instrumental Music by Tim Janis. My instrumental music can help you find deep relaxation, relieve anxiety, and find peace. My music incorporates relaxing sounds of nature and features flute music, piano music, harp music, & violin music. I am a composer from The Rocky Mountains and I created my channel as a place to visit, relax and find peace.

Please leave a comment we would love to say hello to you :) Blessings and peace, Tim & Elizabeth, Reno, Roo Roo, Bella, Zunaira, Amna and Paige.

I wrote this new song on the piano as I watch the August light splash across the mountains here at our home. There is such a wonderful peace in the mountains as summer gives way to Autumn. I hope you like my new song :) and we  hope you enjoy our video and thanks so music for watching. Blessings and peace Tim & Elizabeth, Reno, Bella and Roo Roo 

Come visit Elizabeth and I at our Rocky Mountain home :) 
https://youtu.be/WvhZPfPilC4?si=lx8M5YjCdbXro5sF

Please remember to enjoy our other channels

snippet.title: 🌴 DJ PARTY 71 – CALL OF THE SUN | Tropical House / Slap House / Eurodance #2026music
snippet.description:
Feel the rhythm, follow the light and let the music take you beyond the horizon.

“Call of the Sun” blends the warm atmosphere of Tropical House with Latin Urban percussion, tribal drums, Melodic Techno House and powerful Slap House bass. Subtle touches of Eurodance and Hip House add extra energy, while the atmospheric flute melody gives the track its distinctive character.

From the hypnotic tribal intro to the melodic build-up and powerful final drop, the track combines summer freedom, electronic energy and an emotional journey into one modern dance sound.

🎵 Title: Call of the Sun

🎶 Style: Tropical House / Latin Urban / Melodic Techno House / Slap House / Eurodance / Hip House

🎧 Follow ▼@Voltaj ▼
• Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Voltaj

• Twitter: https://x.com/voltajofficial
• Site: https://www.voltaj.ro/
• Magazin: https://www.magazinvoltaj.ro

 ▼ Versuri ▼
Te catarai pe mine, pielea-ti de catifea
Si-mi urlai in ureche: Hai, gata! Trezirea!
E weekend, da-o-ncolo, doar 5 ore am dormit
Uita-te la desene ca tati-i obosit.
Tipam “Pune-ti centura! Nu da iaurt pe jos!”
Acum bancheta-i luna, as vrea sa fiu nervos
Sa pot tipa la tine ca nu-i bine ce faci
Si-mi spun trist in oglinda: acuma vad ca taci!

Si-as vrea sa stau cu tine, sa fiu un pic mai bun
Sa fac din luni, marti, miercuri, joi si orice zi, Craciun!
Poti sa treci pe la mine, daca iti e in drum
M-as bucura la fel ca tine-n seara de Ajun!

Trageam mereu de tine sa-nveti si tu mai mult
Stiam eu tot ce-i bine dar nu stiam s-ascult
Tranteai usa intruna sa scapi de gura mea
Azi ordinea-i perfecta dar goala-i camera
Da-mi inc-o zi, atata, s-am iar 30 de ani
Nu as rata o clipa, n-as fugi dupa bani
As sta lipit de tine si-al tau zambet divin
De ce sa vad doar norii, cand tu esti cer senin

Si-as vrea sa stau cu tine, sa fiu un pic mai bun
Sa fac din luni, marti, miercuri, joi si orice zi, Craciun!
Poti sa treci pe la mine, daca iti e in drum
M-as bucura la fel ca tine-n seara de Ajun!

Acum totul e bine, e liniste, dorm tun
Curata-i toata casa, gunoiu-i dus acum
In colt stau pe fotoliu, astept, poate-ai sa  suni
Sa-mi spui ca treci pe-acasa, la masa de Craciun

snippet.description:
Welcome to NOMAD DRIVE full gameplay! Repair your rundown RV and hit the road in a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic world. Gather resources, customize your RV, and survive as long as you can!

Follow Me Here:
➜ http://instagram.com/thefoosterchannel 
➜ Twitter/X: https://twitter.com/thafooster

ABOUT NOMAD DRIVE:
Discover a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic world. Each new game offers a different starting point and experience, allowing you to collect resources and survive in abandoned locations and roads.
Explore a continuously shifting world of distinct biomes. Each unique region offers its own specific climate and ecosystem.
Begin your journey with a rundown RV, repairing and upgrading each part. Personalize everything from stoves and refrigerators to toilets and seating areas, creating your own living space. Stay alive with activities such as cooking, fishing, repairing, and making coffee. Use your RV's kitchen to cook the food you find, making more nutritious meals.
Discover Nomad Drive, where every part is fully interactive. Touch, customize, and explore everything from furniture to appliances. Make the RV truly yours!
Plant the fruit and vegetable seeds you discover in the world of Nomad Drive in pots and grow them by taking care of them. They will reward you with delicious fruits and vegetables.

Game Link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2223980/Nomad_Drive/

snippet.description:
Now that the majority of Scrappers Street has been completed, we move onto another main section of the Complex base.

First we blot out the sky, which is a fancy way of saying we build a big black ceiling. Then we attach 2 massive columns and a big sign onto our Storage Room to make it into the Storage Depot of the city. I also show off some new Jump Pad tech I've been trying to get working on multiplayer.

We end the episode with some fun and games. We check out Docm's "Ice Climbers" game, our entry into the "Kill A Tango" competition, and go golfing for my first time at Cub's amazing "Hermit Groves" golf course.
